{'text': '將駕駛執照的數碼版本加入iPhone，看來即將在美國第15個州推出。', 'source': "Bringing a digital version of your driver's license to your iPhone appears to be on the verge of expanding to a 15th U.S. state."}

{'text': '蘋果目前已列出14個州及波多黎各支援此功能，後端資產顯示將會有另一個州加入……', 'source': 'Apple currently lists 14 states and Puerto Rico as supported, and backend assets indicate another one is joining the list…'}

{'text': '許多人一直希望能夠放棄實體身份證明文件，例如駕駛執照和護照，只需透過iPhone或Apple Watch出示數碼身份證即可。', 'source': "Many people have long hoped to ditch physical identity documents like driver's licenses and passports, and present digital IDs from an iPhone or Apple Watch."}

{'text': '這個未來可能仍需一段時間才能實現，但蘋果在2021年已開始積極推動，當時宣布計劃讓iPhone用戶可以將駕駛執照或州身份證加入銀包應用程式（Wallet app）。目前已有14個州採用此功能：', 'source': "That future may still be a ways off, but Apple started pushing toward it in 2021, when it announced plans to let iPhone users add their driver's license or state ID to the Wallet app. Today, 14 states have adopted the feature:"}

  • {'text': '亞利桑那州', 'source': 'Arizona'}
  • {'text': '阿肯色州', 'source': 'Arkansas'}
  • {'text': '加利福尼亞州', 'source': 'California'}
  • {'text': '科羅拉多州', 'source': 'Colorado'}
  • {'text': '佐治亞州', 'source': 'Georgia'}
  • {'text': '夏威夷州', 'source': 'Hawaii'}
  • {'text': '伊利諾伊州', 'source': 'Illinois'}
  • {'text': '愛荷華州', 'source': 'Iowa'}
  • {'text': '馬里蘭州', 'source': 'Maryland'}
  • {'text': '蒙大拿州', 'source': 'Montana'}
  • {'text': '新墨西哥州', 'source': 'New Mexico'}
  • {'text': '北達科他州', 'source': 'North Dakota'}
  • {'text': '俄亥俄州', 'source': 'Ohio'}
  • {'text': '西維吉尼亞州', 'source': 'West Virginia'}

{'text': 'MacRumors發現的後端資產顯示，俄克拉荷馬州即將加入這個行列。', 'source': 'Backend assets discovered by MacRumors suggest Oklahoma is set to join the list.'}

{'text': '我們先前曾提供詳細的教學，介紹如何在iPhone的銀包應用程式中加入駕駛執照或州身份證。當時已提及，請緊記數碼身份證並不能完全取代實體文件，所以目前我們建議繼續攜帶「塑膠版本」（實體卡）。', 'source': 'We previously provided a detailed tutorial on how to add your driver\'s license or state ID to your iPhone\'s Wallet app. As we noted then, remember that digital IDs are not a complete replacement for physical documents, so we still recommend carrying the "plastic version" for now.'}

{'text': '然而，數碼版本可在合資格的TSA（美國運輸安全管理局）安檢站以及需要向商戶證明年齡的場合協助保護你的私隱。系統只會確認你符合年齡要求，不會透露任何個人資料，例如出生日期。', 'source': 'However, the digital version can help protect your privacy at eligible TSA checkpoints and when you need to prove your age to a business. The system only confirms that you meet the age requirement, and does not reveal any personal information, such as your date of birth.'}
